about.title: About this project
about.datasetText: This platform hosts human evaluation for the Catalan YouTube Speech Corpus: 231,700 short clips of spontaneous Catalan speech, automatically extracted from public YouTube videos by Softcatalà, the volunteer organization behind free and open-source Catalan-language software. Each clip comes with two independent, machine-generated transcription candidates, along with automatically detected speaker gender and clip timing.
about.whyText: The transcripts were produced automatically, not reviewed by a person, so the dataset is raw and unvalidated — useful for large-scale training, but not a reliable benchmark on its own. Where the two automatic candidates agree, the text is usually trustworthy; where they diverge, the clip is often noisy, overlapping speech, or otherwise hard to transcribe.
about.goalText: Every vote you cast — on a transcription, a speaker gender, or a detected dialect — helps build a human-validated layer on top of this raw automatic data: surfacing which transcriptions can be trusted, catching what the models got wrong, and producing higher-confidence data that can be used to improve Catalan speech recognition.
